shared_context.topic: differential diagnosis of right lower abdominal pain

atoms.1: Right lower abdominal pain has several potential causes.
atoms.2: Appendicitis is a common cause of right lower quadrant abdominal pain.
atoms.3: Appendicitis is particularly common in young adults.
atoms.4: Appendicitis occurs when the appendix becomes inflamed.
atoms.5: Appendicitis often occurs due to a blockage or infection.
atoms.6: Symptoms of appendicitis may include pain that starts near the navel and then moves to the lower right abdomen.
atoms.7: Symptoms of appendicitis may include nausea.
atoms.8: Symptoms of appendicitis may include vomiting.
atoms.9: Symptoms of appendicitis may include loss of appetite.
atoms.10: Symptoms of appendicitis may include fever.
atoms.11: Ovarian cysts are fluid-filled sacs that can develop on the ovaries.
atoms.12: Ovarian torsion occurs when the ovary twists, cutting off its blood supply.
atoms.13: Ovarian cysts can cause right lower abdominal pain.
atoms.14: Ovarian torsion can cause right lower abdominal pain.
atoms.15: Right lower abdominal pain from ovarian conditions is more likely if the cyst or ovary is located on the right side.
atoms.16: Kidney stones can cause severe pain in the right lower back or side.
atoms.17: Pain from kidney stones may radiate to the abdomen.
atoms.18: Pain from kidney stones is often accompanied by nausea.
atoms.19: Pain from kidney stones is often accompanied by vomiting.
atoms.20: Pain from kidney stones is often accompanied by frequent urination.
atoms.21: Diverticulitis is an inflammation of the diverticula.
atoms.22: Diverticula are small pouches in the wall of the colon.
atoms.23: Diverticulitis can cause right lower abdominal pain.
atoms.24: Right lower abdominal pain from diverticulitis is more likely if the affected diverticula are located in the right colon.
atoms.25: Gastrointestinal issues can cause right lower abdominal pain.
atoms.26: Conditions such as irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) can cause right lower abdominal pain.
atoms.27: Conditions such as inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) can cause right lower abdominal pain.
atoms.28: Conditions such as gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) can cause right lower abdominal pain.
atoms.29: It is essential to consult a healthcare professional for a proper diagnosis and treatment plan.
atoms.30: A healthcare professional will likely perform a physical examination.
atoms.31: A healthcare professional will likely take a medical history.
atoms.32: A healthcare professional may order imaging tests such as an ultrasound to determine the underlying cause of symptoms.
atoms.33: A healthcare professional may order imaging tests such as a CT scan to determine the underlying cause of symptoms.
atoms.34: A healthcare professional may order imaging tests such as an MRI to determine the underlying cause of symptoms.

snippets.output: Right lower abdominal pain has several potential causes.
Appendicitis is a common cause of right lower quadrant abdominal pain, and it is particularly common in young adults.
snippets.notes: Both atoms describe properties of appendicitis as a cause; 33yo female fits the young-adult demographic.

snippets.output: Appendicitis occurs when the appendix becomes inflamed, often due to a blockage or infection.
Symptoms of appendicitis may include pain that starts near the navel and then moves to the lower right abdomen, nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite, and fever.
Ovarian cysts are fluid-filled sacs that can develop on the ovaries.
Ovarian torsion occurs when the ovary twists, cutting off its blood supply.
snippets.notes: Standalone definition of ovarian torsion (distinct entity from cysts).

snippets.output: Ovarian cysts and ovarian torsion can cause right lower abdominal pain, especially if the cyst or ovary is located on the right side.
snippets.notes: Conclusion (RLQ pain from ovarian conditions) with the side-localization premise; highly relevant for a 33yo female.

snippets.output: Kidney stones can cause severe pain in the right lower back or side, which may radiate to the abdomen.
snippets.notes: Pain location plus radiation; generally true and applicable.

snippets.output: Pain from kidney stones is often accompanied by nausea, vomiting, and frequent urination.
snippets.notes: Enumeration of associated symptoms of kidney-stone pain.

snippets.output: Diverticulitis is an inflammation of the diverticula, which are small pouches in the wall of the colon.
snippets.notes: Definition plus property of diverticula (same subject).

snippets.output: Diverticulitis can cause right lower abdominal pain, especially if the affected diverticula are located in the right colon.
snippets.notes: Conclusion plus localization premise. Diverticulitis is uncommon at age 33 (typically >50) and right-sided diverticulitis is rare in Western populations, so this is an atypical differential for this patient, but it is not strictly false in context.

snippets.output: Gastrointestinal issues, including irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), can cause right lower abdominal pain.
snippets.notes: Enumeration of GI causes of RLQ pain.

snippets.output: Conditions such as gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) can cause right lower abdominal pain.
snippets.notes: GERD causes epigastric/retrosternal pain, not right lower abdominal pain. Incorrect both generally and for this 33yo female.

snippets.output: It is essential to consult a healthcare professional for a proper diagnosis and treatment plan.
A healthcare professional will likely perform a physical examination and take a medical history.
A healthcare professional may order imaging tests such as an ultrasound, CT scan, or MRI to determine the underlying cause of symptoms.
snippets.notes: Enumeration of imaging modalities for the same purpose.
